claim: Placeholder: assess whether politically active electorate experienced worsening relative position or expectation-reality gap before cutoff.
mechanism_to_next_layer: No causal transition assumed; evidence required for participation -> grievance -> institutional behavior.
alternative_explanations: Alternative: dissatisfaction may remain electoral and nonviolent; aggregate inequality may not map to active voters.

claim: Placeholder: identify evidence-supported legitimacy-bearing groups and whether any experienced status loss.
mechanism_to_next_layer: Potential effect only through documented changes in trust, political behavior, mobilization or institutional alignment.
alternative_explanations: Group definition itself may be contested and must not be inferred from stereotypes.

claim: Placeholder: seasonal and anomalous climate conditions relevant to agriculture, water, infrastructure and household pressure.
mechanism_to_next_layer: Climate -> crop/water/energy/income pathway must be separately demonstrated.
alternative_explanations: Normal seasonal variability may explain observed changes.

claim: Placeholder: food prices, affordability, agricultural output and regional access.
mechanism_to_next_layer: Food pressure can affect household stress only where affordability/access mechanism is evidenced.
alternative_explanations: National availability can coexist with local affordability problems and vice versa.

claim: Placeholder: water availability, quality, infrastructure and regional access.
mechanism_to_next_layer: Water stress requires local mechanism; national averages are insufficient.
alternative_explanations: Water stress may be localized or seasonal.

claim: Placeholder: household energy affordability, fuel availability, grid reliability and regional delivery.
alternative_explanations: Energy-sector stress may not translate into political pressure.
